# CRS Gas

> CRS Gas is a local LPG gas refill and delivery business serving homes and businesses in Boksburg, Germiston and Benoni, Gauteng, South Africa.

CRS Gas was founded by Christo Jordaan. Although the business is new, Christo has previous experience working in gas companies and extensive knowledge across the gas sector. CRS Gas currently focuses on LPG cylinder refills and refill delivery. Cylinder sales and cylinder exchanges are not currently advertised services.

The current website refill prices are 5kg R150, 9kg R300, 14kg R500, 19kg R620 and 48kg R1450. Prices are subject to confirmation when an order is placed.

CRS Gas serves Boksburg, Germiston and Benoni. Customers should contact CRS Gas to confirm delivery availability for their specific suburb or address.

Customers can submit an LPG refill order through the website or contact the team directly by WhatsApp or telephone.

Contact:
- Christo Jordaan — Phone and WhatsApp: +27 67 116 1984
- Ronnie — Phone and WhatsApp: +27 60 565 0595
